answer_1.quote: We propose two tasks to evaluate the capability of LLMs to handle scrambled text. (1) Scrambled Sentence Recovery (ScrRec). In this task, we provide a sentence containing scrambled words to LLMs and then ask them to recover the original sentence from it. (2) Scrambled Question Answering (ScrQA).
answer_1.outputs: Recovered sentences for ScrRec; answers to questions for ScrQA
